page: Microsoft Azure NG16ads_V620_v1 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the NGADSV620v1 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The hardware configuration includes a fractional GPU allocation of 0.5 AMD V620 GPU with 15 GB of dedicated VRAM.

For local storage, the instance is equipped with 2444 GB of NVMe SSD capacity and is premium storage capable. This high-capacity local storage provides significant space for disk-intensive operations. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network configuration or translation for public internet access.

The resource allocation presents specific architectural tradeoffs. While the instance provides substantial local NVMe storage and fractional GPU acceleration, the memory-to-vCPU ratio is relatively low at 2.0 GB per core. This profile is designed for workloads that require GPU-assisted rendering, cloud gaming, or media processing alongside high-speed local storage, rather than memory-intensive database caching. The fractional GPU allocation offers a cost-efficient entry point for tasks that do not require a full dedicated GPU.
